prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Hotkeys", "Try pressing the hotkeys below to see how easy it is to wake, hide, or talk to your new desktop companion.", "Press Option+P to toggle pet visibility", "Test Shortcut"]
1: ["Signing in automatically restores your previously saved desktop pets and account progress."]
2: ["Control Your Pet Right from the Desktop", "Interact with your pet anytime using quick action shortcuts or system tray commands.", "Quick Action Controls"]
3: ["Your desktop pets and customization traits automatically sync whenever you log into your account."]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Assets", "Your companion is getting configured for desktop activation.", "Initializing desktop overlays..."]
5: ["All customized traits and companion memories are safely backed up to your account."]
6: ["Next: Try Commands", "Quick Desktop Commands", "Practice essential commands to summon, talk to, or minimize your desktop pet instantly.", "Practice Summon (Cmd+Shift+P)"]
7: ["Almost Ready for Desktop!", "Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick commands."]
8: ["Already have a pet? Sign in to immediately link and activate your existing companions."]
9: ["Calibrate Desktop Pet", "Calibrate Your Companion", "Test pet hiding, positioning, and interaction controls before placing them on your desktop.", "Test Desktop Visibility"]
